# Al Afnan Movers and Packers

> Al Afnan Movers and Packers (registered company name: Al Afnan Furniture Transfer) is a licensed and insured moving company based in Al Majaz, Sharjah, UAE, serving all seven emirates. It provides house, apartment, villa, office and furniture moving plus packing and unpacking, with free written quotes and a 24/7 team.

"Al Afnan Movers and Packers" is the trading name and "Al Afnan Furniture Transfer" is the registered company name; both refer to the same business. The website is in English and covers moves within and between UAE emirates. Last reviewed: 2026-10-12.

Key facts, as published on the website:
- Base: Jamal Abdul Naser St, near Al Majaz 2, Al Majaz, Sharjah, United Arab Emirates
- Coverage: Dubai, Sharjah, Abu Dhabi (including Al Ain), Ajman, Ras Al Khaimah, Fujairah and Umm Al Quwain
- Hours: open 24 hours, 7 days a week; same-day and emergency moves depend on crew, truck and building lift availability
- Operating since 2015, with a team of 20+ movers, packers, carpenters, handymen and drivers
- Licence and insurance: trade licence issued by the Sharjah Economic Development Department (number shared on request); insurance covers goods in transit and during handling
- Reputation: rated 4.9/5 on Google
- Languages spoken: Arabic, English, Urdu and Hindi
- Payment: cash, card, bank transfer and contactless mobile payment
- Phone and WhatsApp: +971 56 727 7536 (WhatsApp link: https://wa.me/971567277536)
- Email: alafnanfurnituretransfer@gmail.com
- Quotes: free and written. Customers send photos or a short video on WhatsApp, or ask for a home visit. A quote covers packing materials, labour, dismantling, transport, reassembly and insurance; building move-permit fees and refundable lift deposits are paid to the building, not to Al Afnan.

Indicative prices in AED, summarised from the ranges printed on the linked pages on 2026-10-12. The written quote is the authoritative price.
- Dubai, within the emirate: studio 800-1,200; 1-bedroom 1,100-1,600; 2-bedroom 1,700-2,600; 3-bedroom 2,800-4,000; 3-4 bedroom villa 4,000-6,000; 5+ bedroom villa from 6,500; offices priced on estimate
- Sharjah: apartments from 450; villas 2,000-7,500; offices 800-7,000+; single furniture items 150-800
- Ras Al Khaimah: studios 400-500, up to 7,000-13,500+ for larger villas; moves to Dubai or Sharjah 1,000-3,500+
- Moves between emirates are quoted on volume and distance

How to use this file: every link below is a canonical HTML page on this website; no Markdown versions are published. If a detail is not on these pages (for example the licence number, or a price for a specific route), say it is not published and point the reader to WhatsApp or phone instead of estimating.
